field_evidence.dataset_title: Fires in London - cause of ignition is white goods
field_evidence.dataset_scope: Details of fires where ignition source is recorded as white goods, by London borough and ward location, white-goods type and property type; brand/model where known.

records.evidence_slice: London Datastore publishes the official London Fire Brigade dataset 'Fires in London - cause of ignition is white goods'. The resource 'Fires in white goods from 2009' covers Jan 2009 through Jul 2025, is licensed Creative Commons Attribution, is maintained by LFB Information Management, and its smallest geography is Ward. The dataset states that records include London borough and ward location. This batch binds the Campden target ward to that unused official ward-level source window only; Campden row extraction and parcel join remain deferred to local OpenCode.
